question: Board round 1 Claude TUI seats hb1cl/hb1cl3 showed no genuine progress for 35-45 min on this PR's runtime (sealed route, XDG_STATE_HOME empty). Is the PR's runtime the cause?
method: One claude seat via cr-board.py --only claude, heartbeat_only, XDG_STATE_HOME=<empty dir>, scratch venvs copied from ah-board-sys7 (PR runtime at 03319d42) and the same copy reinstalled with origin/main b6a482fa (main runtime); the pinned worktree of each as cwd.

hb1cl3_bundle.tui_session_kwargs_identical_across_runt: tests/data/seat_jail_1132_sealed_tui_session_golden.json (captured from main; asserted on this runtime)

pr_runtime.status: stopped by the investigator after 65 min (third thinking-only turn)

finding: Not caused by this PR's runtime. On both runtimes, with byte-identical argv, environment keys, prompt and session kwargs, Claude Opus 5.5 at effort max spends the full 128000-token output budget thinking on the 440 KB sealed prompt (~20 min per turn), hits max_tokens with no text, and Claude Code injects its own continuation. No text reaches the transcript during a thinking turn, so the monitor records no genuine progress for 20-60 min. How many thinking-only turns precede the review is stochastic (main: 1 then OK at 39 min; PR: 3 and still thinking at 65 min; n=1 each). The seat's TCP connection to the API stayed established throughout; the TUI was idle in ep_poll, not blocked on a modal.
not_caused_by: a first-run or trust modal (none: the prompt was submitted at 00:04:50 and the API connection was live)
follow_up_suggestion: outside this PR: bound thinking for sealed Claude seats on large bundles (lower effort, or a thinking budget), or deliver the bundle by pointer (the jailed route this PR adds, once agent-harness#1071 and P2 land)
